---
title: "uv-python dataframe display limits"
engine: uv-python
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
uv-python:
  with:
    - pandas
  dataframe:
    max-rows: 5
    max-cols: 4
---

This fixture uses transient pandas and custom dataframe display limits.

```{python}
import pandas as pd

df = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        f"c{column}": [f"r{row}c{column}" for row in range(8)]
        for column in range(6)
    },
    index=pd.Index([f"row-{row}" for row in range(8)], name="row_id"),
)

df
```
